module: Vue wizard for configuring a bus route (port of the old Angular busRoute module, kept next to "menu.busRoutes" behind a feature flag). Same structure as quickraceWizard; shares the oneshotRaceCore.lua backend and differs only by the Lua configurator (busroute_busrouteConfigurator). Root = welcome screen, children = choice of level (with "middle" sub-step = choice of the route) and of vehicle.
notes: Route configuration module: it exports no function. routeManager reads it (via the ui_router_routes_<name> extension) when routes.lua includes it with `{ include = "<name>" }`.
The keys of `Children` form the segments of the dotted name: "<module>.<child>". `children` (lowercase) in a node designates its sub-routes; `include` mounts another module there.
`ui` is inherited by child routes (uiTypes, uiTypesFilter, infoBar, topBar, uiApps, uiNav, triggerPause): a child redefines it only for what changes.
The onEnter hooks are "extension.function" strings called by the router on entering the route.

Root.desc: {screenId = "busRouteWizard", title = "ui.playmodes.bus", onEnter = "busroute_busrouteConfigurator.onWizardRouteEnter", root scopeTree, Vue only, infoBar and topBar hidden}

Children.desc: Children: level (onEnter onWizardLevelRouteEnter, minor sub-route level.middle -> onWizardMiddleRouteEnter) and vehicle (onWizardVehicleRouteEnter). They use a grid selector scopeTree (grid-selector-grid / grid-selector-details with back to the grid).

ModuleName.desc: Name of the routes module (first segment of the dotted name).
